labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for new ReprHighlighter behaviour (unit styling); features go through Discussions first.

body:
Please discuss this in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) first: new features are approved there before an issue is opened.

You can already style units yourself by subclassing `RegexHighlighter` with your own `highlights` list (see https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/highlighter.py). #3318 covers the same number regex for separators and binary forms, so it is worth reading alongside any proposal.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
